multi_entity_note: Two parties: Modus Media International (MMI) and Dragon Systems, Inc., with separate addresses.
processing_note: MMI will invoice Dragon Systems based on actual shipments that have been performed.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading names it the Outsourcing Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: No dated preamble; the parties signed on 12 Jan. 1998 (Dragon) and 19 Jan. 1998 (MMI), the later completing execution.

contract.effective_date.rationale: "EFFECTIVE AS OF (EFFECTIVE DATE)" is an unfilled placeholder; no effective date is stated.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement is valid for an indefinite period.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 13, despite its heading, only names possible forums (Massachusetts or Netherlands courts), not a governing law.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Indefinite term with no renewal provision.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal; the sixty-day notice is for termination without cause.
